Markets.title: OPEC+ set to keep oil production targets steady: Report
Markets.summary: OPEC+ is expected to maintain its oil production targets for the first quarter of 2027 despite internal data disputes and the conflict involving Iran. The group faces mounting pressure from potential global oil surpluses and recent member exits.

Markets.title: Copper sweeps higher as China offers stock market support
Markets.summary: Copper prices increased after China's cabinet announced support for the stock market, following a significant price drop earlier in the month. Additionally, China's October industrial profits reached their highest growth in five months, while the Yangshan premium indicated strong demand for copper imports.

Markets.title: Gold pares gains as Fed-hike risks linger, eyes first weekly rise in three weeks
Markets.summary: Gold prices are on track for their first weekly gain in three weeks, up by nearly 2.5% despite ongoing pressures from a strong US dollar and rising Treasury yields. This recovery is supported by a notable increase in physical gold demand from India and China following a recent drop to a 15-month low.

Markets.title: Blackstone sells 1.55% stake in IGI for Rs 280 crore to meet public shareholding norms
Markets.summary: Blackstone sold a 1.55% stake in International Gemological Institute for Rs 280 crore through block deals. This transaction reduced Blackstone's holding to 75% to comply with Sebi's minimum public shareholding requirements.

Markets.title: Capital market industry hopes for relief in capital gains taxation in Budget 2027-28: Axis Capital MD
Markets.summary: Axis Capital MD Lakha Nair stated that the capital market industry anticipates relief on capital gains taxation in the upcoming Union Budget 2027-28. This expectation includes a potential reduction in the short-term capital gains tax.

Markets.title: Nasdaq jumps 2%, Dow gains 600 pts as US stocks log weekly gains: Stock Market Live Updates
Markets.summary: US stocks registered weekly gains as the Nasdaq jumped 2% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 600 points. The market advance was reported during live stock market updates.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and his political rivals are making their final appeals to voters ahead of the election. While Sánchez aims to defy unfavorable poll numbers, his opponents are accusing him of dishonesty and betrayal.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized Donald Trump for having a strange friendship with Vladimir Putin in a BBC interview. Zelensky also expressed frustration that the United States is not pressuring Russia hard enough in peace negotiations.

Geo-Political.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine is preparing for another devastating winter as the war continues with no end in sight. Citizens and leaders face ongoing uncertainty about how the conflict will eventually conclude.

Geo-Political.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
Geo-Political.summary: Stormy weather in New York City forced organizers to reschedule the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade by two days. This unexpected change left participating marching bands scrambling to cover the resulting extra travel and lodging costs.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
Geo-Political.summary: Brazil is pushing back against French President Emmanuel Macron for describing Brazilian meat as "doped." Macron made the remark to French farming representatives following the European Union's recent ban on Brazilian beef and poultry.

Geo-Political.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
Geo-Political.summary: Kenneth Law apologized in court to the families of his victims after pleading guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide. The Canadian man expressed remorse for his actions during the legal proceedings.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that can reverse engineer almost any application without requiring access to the source code. It allows users to understand how app features work without spending months learning traditional disassemblers and assembly code.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in generating organic traffic through AI rather than traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay ahead of the competition. This guide outlines the top ten AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

Data & Insights.title: China Railway Resources Group bets on Zimbabwe's gold potential with AI mining and $600 million investment plan
Data & Insights.summary: China Railway Resources Group has signed an agreement to invest up to $600 million to revive and expand four gold mines in Zimbabwe through a partnership with Duration Gold. The project will introduce new financing, engineering expertise, and AI-powered mining technology to sites including Vubachikwe and Gaika.

Data & Insights.title: RBI governor urges MSMEs to free-trade deals; flags low AI adoption
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra urged micro, small, and medium enterprises to utilize free-trade agreements to enhance global market access and value chain specialization. He also highlighted the low rate of artificial intelligence adoption among these small businesses.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs: India gets an edge over China, Vietnam, Bangladesh—but what must New Delhi do to secure it?
Data & Insights.summary: The US has proposed a 17 percent tariff on Indian exports if a trade deal is reached, potentially benefiting India over Asian competitors. However, the offer requires India to meet specific demands regarding market access and trade policies through ongoing negotiations.

Data & Insights.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
Data & Insights.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent, reaching a two-year high. The increase was driven by concerns over inflation exceeding target levels and rising housing prices in Seoul.

Data & Insights.title: UAE eyes 7-8% growth next year as IMF reverses recession forecast, projects 0.2% expansion
Data & Insights.summary: The UAE economy minister targets 7% to 8% growth next year, while the IMF forecasts a modest 0.2% expansion in 2026. This recovery depends on the Iran war, and future investments will prioritize crisis-resilient industries.

Data & Insights.title: India’s Q2 GDP growth to slow marginally to 7.6%, shows Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q2 GDP growth is expected to slow marginally to 7.6%, according to a Mint poll. While a deficient monsoon and uneven rural demand weighed on the economy, resilient manufacturing and services activity provided support.

India.title: Hiding Number Plates To Skip Toll? A Rs 100 Toll Could Cost You Rs 600
India.summary: Motorists in India who hide their number plates to evade toll fees face a penalty of Rs 500. This fine is in addition to the original toll amount, making the total cost Rs 600 for a Rs 100 toll.

India.title: Sharad Pawar Dials Congress, Explains Support For Delimitation: Inside Scoop
India.summary: Sharad Pawar reportedly called the Congress leadership to explain his support for the delimitation process. The 85-year-old leader described this move as a political compulsion.

India.title: Key Accused In Rs 1,280 Crore Chhattisgarh Liquor Scam Brought Back From UAE
India.summary: Vikas Agrawal, the key accused in a ₹1,280 crore Chhattisgarh liquor scam, was brought back from the UAE following an Interpol Red Notice. He was wanted by Chhattisgarh Police for alleged irregularities in the state's liquor distribution system between 2019 and 2022.

India.title: Fake ICSE Certificate Scam With 4,900 Students Busted In Assam, 3 Arrested
India.summary: Assam police arrested three people for running a fake ICSE certificate scam that involved about 4,900 students. The arrests follow a CID investigation into the alleged fabrication and misuse of Class 10 examination documents.

India.title: Chandrababu Naidu Backs Delimitation Push, Flags South's 'Population' Concern
India.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu has supported the Centre's delimitation push while acknowledging the southern states' concerns over population control. He traveled to New Delhi to express his backing for the decisions made under Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership.

India.title: Centre's Delimitation Push: How Numbers Stack Up For NDA In Lok Sabha
India.summary: The National Democratic Alliance's first attempt to pass the delimitation push failed on April 17, 2026, in the Lok Sabha. The coalition received 298 votes in favor, falling short of the required 352 two-thirds majority out of 528 present members.

General.title: Millions lose access to benefits and pensions services after 'cyber incident'
General.summary: Millions of people lost access to benefits and pensions services due to a cyber incident. The Department for Work and Pensions temporarily took these services offline as a precautionary measure.

General.title: Watch: What has happened to DWP online services?
General.summary: The work and pensions secretary announced an investigation into a serious cyber incident. This incident is currently affecting the Department for Work and Pensions' online services.

General.title: Catherine's emotional cancer documentary strips away the stiff upper lip
General.summary: The Princess of Wales has released a documentary titled Heal. In the film, she shares her personal experience with cancer in her own words.

General.title: 'Calculating predator' who blackmailed girls into self-harm jailed for 14 and a half years
General.summary: Beau-Jack Mensforth has been sentenced to 14 and a half years in prison for blackmailing nine young girls into self-harm. The crimes involved victims from around the world, with the youngest aged 12.
